defs.def: to tell people sth officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc. 宣布，宣告（决定、计划等）

ex.s: — Mike will announce his retirement from professional soccer next week.
ex.t: — 迈克下周将宣布他从职业足球退役。他才25岁，身体仍然很健壮。

ex.s: He said the  60  woman will be announced on the website and the trip will be shared online.
ex.t: 他说，这位   60   女性将在网站上公布，旅程也将在网上分享。

ex.s: Country Is Coping With Oil Shortage The President has announced emergency measures to limit fuel consumption.
ex.t: 国家正在应对石油短缺总统宣布了限制燃料消耗的紧急措施。

ex.s: As a result of this evidence, John Snow was able to announce that the pump water carried cholera germs.
ex.t: 由于这一证据， John Snow能够宣布泵水携带霍乱病菌。

ex.s: This book announced the beginning of the English Romantic Movement.
ex.t: 这本书宣告了英国浪漫主义运动的开始。

ex.s: In January 2018, the cloning of two long-tailed monkeys, Zhong Zhong and Hua Hua, was announced by Chinese scientists.
ex.t: 2018年1月，中国科学家宣布克隆中中和华华两只长尾猴。

defs.def: to give information about sth in a public place, especially through a loudspeaker （尤指通过广播）通知
to say sth in a loud and/or serious way 声称；宣称
to tell sb your name or sb else's name when you or they arrive at a place 宣布（某人）到达；通报 … 的到来

ex.s: In her first PE class , Eva was shocked when Coach Pitt announced that everyone had to run one mile around the track outside.
ex.t: 在第一节体育课上，伊娃震惊地发现皮特教练宣布每个人都必须绕着外面的跑道跑一英里。

ex.s: When it was announced in 2018 that the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Shanghai had created the world’s first cloned monkeys, Zhongzhong and Huahua, heated discussions followed online.
ex.t: 2018年，当上海中国科学院宣布创造了世界上第一只克隆猴子时，中中和华华在网上进行了激烈的讨论。

defs.def: to introduce, or to give information about, a programme on the radio or television （在广播或电视中）播音，广播

chunks.cn: 宣布开始 / 宣布突发事件
在…上宣布 / 由…宣布 / 在…中宣布
